description: This file defines the InputView class, a custom view extending FrameLayout, used as the root view for an input method in an Android keyboard implementation. It manages measurement behavior, including optional expansion to full window size.

classes.name: InputView
classes.description: A custom view representing the root container for the input method, with custom measurement logic.

methods.name: InputView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InputView with a context and attribute set.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides the measurement behavior to optionally expand the view to fit the entire window height based on a static flag.

methods.name: getTopInsets
methods.description: Returns the difference between the measured height and the real height, which can be used as inset measurement.
